mechanism.family: Charity fraud: cloned medical fundraiser identity plus advance-fee 'clearing transfer' to a personal account
mechanism.summary: The captured page is a pixel-clone of a GoFundMe medical campaign ("I dream to walk." — Yassin Ghalban, 34) served on the unrelated domain givecharityandhope.com, with GoFundMe navigation, pt-PT chrome and a 'Donate now' button that diverts to the clone's own /yassin/checkout while promising 'Your donation is protected by the: GoFundMe Giving Guarantee'. The synthetic condition: completing a donation requires an extra one-time $150 'clearing transfer' to the campaign's 'verified disbursement account' held by Mariam Ghalban (personal account), which releases the donation to the family only when received and is refundable exclusively as non-withdrawable platform credit.
mechanism.source_basis: FTC 'Donating Through Crowdfunding and Fundraising Platforms' (copied photos/stories, donate only on the platform itself); FTC fake-prize/task advance-fee advisories (pay-first 'processing/release' transfers to personal accounts); Scamwatch charity scam reports.

How donations on givecharityandhope.com reach campaign beneficiaries.

Q: Why does my donation need a clearing transfer? A: To protect beneficiaries from chargebacks, first-time donors complete a one-time clearing transfer of $150.00 to the campaign's verified disbursement account (account holder Mariam Ghalban, personal account). Funds are released to the family once the clearing transfer is received.
Q: When does the family get my donation? A: Donations are hand-delivered within 24 hours of the clearing transfer being confirmed.

Q: Can I get the clearing transfer back? A: Clearing transfers are refunded as platform credit in your givecharityandhope wallet. Platform credit can be used for future donations and is not withdrawable to a bank account.
Q: Is my donation protected? A: This campaign is covered by the GoFundMe Giving Guarantee for eligible donors.
